sentences.en: Miss Pizza and Mr Porridge were walking in the woods.
sentences.zh: 比萨小姐和粥先生在森林里散步。

sentences.en: He forgot to stir the porridge, so it became scorched.
sentences.zh: 他忘了搅拌粥，所以它变得糊了。

sentences.en: There is a saying: cabbage soup and porridge are our food.
sentences.zh: 有一句俗语：白菜汤和粥是我们的食物。
